designAssessment: Approve the stated bounded disjoint operator: whole-account ownership prevents overlapping expenditure; one obligation owner prevents duplicated debt authority; joins count the shared prefix once and add disjoint deltas.
Residual quotas, work, backing and duties partition explicitly. Retirement remains separate and nonrefundable. Sibling lineage constrains joins.

Exact occurrences bind state, stable location, ownership resource, plan, post-state and terminal designation. Their commitments can be constructed before authority and node hashes without a hash cycle.

This approves the bounded design, not the defective currentness implementation, shared-state composition, full38 coverage or product acceptance. This review alone does not establish two agreeing votes.
